verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Relay offers US checking accounts with account/routing numbers (relay-docs-1, relay-docs-7) and invoicing/payment collection (relay-docs-5, relay-docs-11), but nothing indicates local account details in multiple currencies (e.g., EUR, GBP local receiving accounts) — all transfer evidence (ACH, wires) points to a single-currency USD banking product with per-transaction fees for international transfers (relay-comm-5).
